description: This file defines a React functional component named 'ListedActionsOption' which provides UI for listing actions related to a note within a web application. It manages state for opening/closing a menu, handles authorization for a note, and renders UI elements such as menu items, icons, and a popover containing additional actions.

methods.name: ListedActionsOption
methods.description: React functional component that renders listed actions for a note and handles authorization and menu toggle logic.

methods.name: toggleMenu
methods.description: Callback function that authorizes the note if needed and toggles the open state of the actions menu.
